scripts.start: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:web" "npm run start:server"
scripts.start:full: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed && npm run start:server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.deploy:railway: echo '🚂 Railway Deployment Instructions:' && echo '1. Go to https://railway.app' && echo '2. Connect your GitHub repository' && echo '3. Railway will auto-detect railway.toml configuration' && echo '4. Add PostgreSQL database' && echo '5. Deploy!' && echo '' && echo 'Configuration files:' && echo '- railway.toml (deployment config)' && echo '- .railwayignore (files to exclude)' && echo '- Dockerfile (monorepo build)'
scripts.deploy:vercel: echo 'Deploying backend...' && npm run deploy:backend && echo 'Deploying frontend...' && npm run deploy:frontend
